none: PAS FindID 896051: Early Medieval (Anglo-Saxon) coin: silver sceat
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

An Early-Medieval (Anglo-Saxon) silver sceat (proto-penny), dating to AD 680-710. Obverse depicting diademed head right in serpent circle; obverse legend illegible. The reverse has a serpent circle (starting at 6 'o clock) enclosing a bird facing right on latin cross with four annulets in angles; reverse legend reads [...]MVA[...]VA three annulets (unbarred A). Unknown mint. Cf. Abramson( 1994,…
